description: Does the classifier return the HOME's address — and only the home's? The failure that matters is not a missed address but a wrong one: the store on a receipt, the contractor on an invoice letterhead. Ten Bauhaus receipts must never turn a home into Sickla. Every case below carries a decoy address that belongs to the sender.

cases.note: The purchase agreement names the object. Seller lives elsewhere (decoy).
